nodes.label: Arcula Favicon (Ink Splat Mark)
nodes.rationale: A single-path vector silhouette in #2B2927 (a warm near-black), 100x100 viewBox, scaling cleanly down to 16px — an organic splat with one downward drip and one upward spike, chosen over a letterform so the tab icon stays legible at favicon size.

nodes.label: Arcula Brand Identity
nodes.rationale: Monochrome, ink-on-paper: a warm near-black (#2B2927) on white, an organic ink-splat mark for the icon and a heavy grotesque wordmark for the name. Restraint keeps the product's chrome from competing with the artworks it displays.
